evidence_gate1_survives_boundary_correct: Divergent-twin rate under H_dynamic (0.187) remains non-trivial (>5%) and within 50% relative of H_fixed's matched-sample rate (0.167).

Permutation relative effect size under H_dynamic (23.6%) remains non-trivial (>10%) and close to H_fixed's matched-sample effect (31.3%, diff=-7.7%); real structure (S,C predicts some H) persists under both boundary definitions.

Mean per-epoch Pearson correlation between H_fixed and H_dynamic is 0.894 (>0.5); the two boundary definitions are measuring a substantially related underlying historical signal, not unrelated quantities.
evidence_gate1_does_not_survive_boundary: Reconstruction R2 changes materially between H_fixed (0.320) and H_dynamic (0.158, diff=-0.162).
note: This is a robustness gate (1B), not Gate 2. No environmental response variable was used.
